about_short_description.short_description: Scout is an innovative student information system that uses artificial intelligence, specifically crafted for K-12 schools.

product.name: Scout Student Information System (SIS)
product.description: An AI-powered student information system designed for K-12 online schools to automate compliance, attendance tracking, work sample collection, and reporting.

product.name: Scout Compliance Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard that monitors and informs schools about current and upcoming compliance requirements for K-12 online education.

product.name: Automated Attendance Tracking
product.description: A system that automatically tracks student attendance by proactively contacting parents through multiple communication channels.

identifier.value: Automated Work Sample Collection and Audit Preparation

product.name: Automated Work Sample Collection and Audit Preparation
product.description: Automatically collects and compiles representative student work samples from online curriculum platforms into audit-ready packets.

product.name: Automated CALPADS Reporting
product.description: Automatically generates and submits required student data reports to the California Longitudinal Pupil Achievement Data System (CALPADS).
